The remaining declared controls reproduce the same one-failure or three-failure reds their logs record, and the run's standalone counter driver re-run as written prints the same line its own log carries: compacted=1028.0 endpoint=1035, checked=4319 endpoint_mismatches=4319, exit 1. The head's own full-file gate re-run here is 17 passed in 8.90s, exit 0, on all_debug (baseline_gate.log), matching the reviewed run's pytest.log tail of 17 passed in 8.59s followed by All checks passed!; the store module was byte-identical to the reviewed run's recorded digest (sha256 ae60b6bf99239c63dc445d92b1c82a70703cbcf4ecdad8f10ca4aa30a2b4b12c) after all fifteen runs, every restore printing CLEAN; docked because four of the twelve declared controls state their mutation as prose rather than as a line pair, so their replay is a reconstruction of the input and not a replay of it, and because the declared list names twelve controls while the run's directory holds a thirteenth control log (negative_control_driver.log) that the list omits.
justifications.fit: the added lines stay inside the file's idiom -- the written geometry table beside the fixture constants, one parametrised case, why-first docstrings -- and the three naming checks over the commit's twenty-four added lines return no hit; docked because the same coverage claim is stated twice, once in the table's comment and again in the pin case's docstring, so the file carries two paragraphs where the mapping comment alone would carry it.
